No patient-case projection, no total/subtype/origin/age sum; no conversion from tests or rates into cases. SPF hospital field denominator says emergency passages while narrative says admissions; both are retained without recalculation. https://www.who.int/tools/flunet
records.primary_source_label: Timor-Leste WHO FluNet Weekly Respiratory Laboratory Surveillance
records.provenance_note: Registered source observations are retained for provenance and downloads, but their measure is not eligible for the public cases curve.
